title: AtlasNLP : A Country-Aware Atlas of Dataset Representation in NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Mapping and quantifying the geographic distribution of NLP datasets by extracting represented countries (populations represented) and producer countries (institutional origins) from over 13,000 ACL dataset records to identify disparities in global coverage.

Analyzing the distribution of explicitly represented countries within widely used language categories (e.g., English, Spanish, Chinese) to demonstrate that broad language metadata often obscures narrow geographic and population representation.

Comparing country-level dataset coverage against World Bank national income categories and university counts to evaluate the alignment between dataset availability and institutional/economic capacity.
